name: Target: Hive'Regal Burrowers
label: Quest
description: Target: Hive'Regal Burrowers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Regal where your primary target will consist of Hive'Regal burrowers.
Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You wish to tell me something, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. Your part in the attack on Hive'Regal has been noted.
